We all have dreams, mostly. Here are a list of some of my dreams I've had that've stuck in my mind for a long time.

Recently (4-5 months ago) I've been dreaming of a (fictional) city called "Mountain Valley." It was a nice little town. Not too many folk lived there I reckon, but enough to where you could meet a friendly stranger or two often, but for the most part, everybody knew everybody, and if you didn't, your friend's friend did. My first dream of Mountain Valley came in the form of me staying at a nice log cabin inn called "The Smoky Mountain Inn," just on the outskirts of the city. Now I do reckon quite the earthquake happened during my stay. For some reason or another we decided to venture into the basement area, which had been completely torn apart by the quake. It opened up a cave of sorts, almost a tomb-like place. Why we found skeletons, buried treasure, and a whole 'nother castle beneath our quiet town. Well, it wasn't all that much mine as it was the people's. Reckon I wasn't even from there, I was most likely a mere visitor, as I was, in fact, staying in an inn. We'll get to that part shortly. The aftershock began and the other guests and I were-a-lookin' to scurry outta there in the fastest possible way. Unfortunately, we lost a couple of people along the way out due to fallin' rocks and other nonsense.

BOOM I wake up.

A few nights later, I go to sleep. I'm in my house in the city. All of a sudden, it's flooded. There's no slow progression leading up to it, it's just flooded. Well shit. I need to get the fuck outta there. BAM! I'm just outside the city, about 25 miles from the inn. Wait, what the fuck? there's a black helicopter landing, it's da Prez. Obama, inviting me into the helicopter. Okay, cool. I get in the chopper, Michele? Sasha? Malia? What the hell? Prez debriefs me, I can't hear him, my ears are ringing. Mountain Valley is lost, something went horribly wrong with something, and now the entire area is fucked.

I wake up.

Next dream is not so detailed. I'm in the "dirty," "darker" part of the city, skateboarding around the empty roads at night. No power, abandoned cars flipped over. I must've gone back for something. Probably a teddy bear.

That's all I can remember from that dream. A lot of the time, I am able to lucid dream, and whatever I think, becomes reality. I'll be looking down at a newspaper, when I suddenly get the thought, "You know it'd really suck if a monster appeared once I look up from this paper." I look up, BAM! Super ugly monster dude. If I don't look up, I think "It'd really suck if he tore the paper out of my hand." BAM! Tears the paper outta my hand. "Dude, I was fucking reading that." So, because of that, I've taken to calling my dream world "Murphyland." Anything that could go wrong, will.

What are some of your more vivid dreams?
